title: Tiltboard: AM sprint scratchpad
content:
Morning quick capture (tiltboard) - Priya
Date: 2026-03-13

Top of mind
- Final PRD edits: section 'rollback criteria' needs clearer SLI thresholds (latency p95 > 450ms for 5m -> auto-fallback). Add fallback model variants table.
- Double-check commit for Dedicated capacity numbers before sending to finance.
- Need one-sentence exec summary for sync at 2pm.

PRD edit notes (in-doc line refs)
- Intro: tighten problem statement to focus on inference economics not encode all context. Remove long background paragraph.
- Add small diagram: routing policy -> model variant -> fallback. (placeholder)
- Metrics table: change column header 'est. cost per token' -> 'expected $/1k tokens'. Use numbers from cost-runbook.xlsx (ask Daniel for latest).
- API contract: ensure streaming error behavior documented (error types + retry hints).

Action items / follow-ups (quick)
- @Daniel: confirm Dedicated pool sizing calc (was 12 -> might need 16 GPUs after new seq length numbers). Ping by 11:30am. (JIRA: PROD-4123 comment)
- @Lena: final UX copy for quota error modal due EOD. If not, fallback message must be generic. (UX-887)
- Ops: request temp increase in logs retention for rollout window (3 days -> 14 days). CC Alex S.
- Legal: confirm data retention note for Private deployments (short ask). Email template: draft in 'legal-template-dp-v1'

Launch checklist (short form, for my eyes)
[ ] Canary open to 5% traffic in eu-west1 (monitor p95, error rate)
[ ] Verify streaming boundary cases: empty prompt, long prompt (>8k tokens)
[ ] Run smoke test script: scripts/smoke/launch-tiltboard.sh (on my laptop; last ran 2026-03-10)
[ ] Confirm bucket with rollout artifacts has 2x checksum copies
[ ] Update 'known-issues' doc with any prelaunch caveats

Risks / unknowns
- Regression on chat formatting when switching to quantized variant (low confidence). Need eval run on N=50 prompts. Who owns? Research/Applied-ML.
- Cost spike if batching threshold misconfigured (look at logs from last canary). Quick query saved as 'canary-cost-query-tiltboard'

Meeting prep notes (2pm sync)
- 2 slides: 1) rollout plan + timing 2) rollback triggers and owners (ops, platform, product)
- Ask: approval to extend canary period by 24h if p95 unstable
- Decision needed: allow reduced feature set for early canary (no tool-calling) -> impacts UX; need buy-in from growth

Quick drafts / phrases for Slack/Email
- Slack: "Canary going to 5% in eu-west1 at 14:30. Watch p95 and errors. Ping me if you see >3% 5xx or p95 >450ms."
- Email to execs: 2-sentence blurb + link to live dashboard + expected impact numbers (latency, cost).

Notes to self (messy)
- Remember: include credit for infra team in writeup (michael helped w/ batching tune)
- Remove TODO: 'revisit quantization note' before marking PRD final
- Quick check: were we using 8-bit or 4-bit quantization baseline? note: internal convo said 4-bit for smaller models, confirm with infra.

Open questions (need answers before EOD)
1) Who is owner for canary rollback script? (ops or platform eng?) -> assign ops unless platform volunteers
2) Is there an established SLA for private deployment trial customers? (ticket in legal/finance)
3) Do we need a separate support rotation for launch day? If yes, rota spreadsheet needs updating

Random micro-notes
- Potential follow-up post-launch: short survey for internal devs on generated output quality (5 quick Qs)
- Save a snapshot of eval prompts used for prelaunch regression check: /evals/tiltboard/prelaunch-2026-03-11.json

End capture. Will convert items into JIRA tasks after 11:00am triage.
